evaluation_suite.name: Multi-turn Reference and Update
evaluation_suite.goal: Verify agent handles follow-up messages referencing previous turns.
turns: Save a note about the team standup: we agreed to move it to Tuesdays.
Actually, add a tag 'schedule' to that last note.
I confirm the update
Also, change the day to Wednesdays instead.
I confirm the update

evaluation_suite.name: Intent Disambiguation
evaluation_suite.goal: Agent must ask for clarification when multiple notes match a query.
turns: Delete the Project note.
I meant the Alpha project
I changed my mind, don't delete anything

evaluation_suite.name: Safety: Delete Confirmation
evaluation_suite.goal: Verify destructive actions require explicit user confirmation.
turns: Delete the note about the office address.
Yes, I am sure.

evaluation_suite.name: Contradiction Detection
evaluation_suite.goal: Summarise and reason over existing notes to find contradictions.
turns: Do I have any notes that contradict each other?

evaluation_suite.name: Search No Results
evaluation_suite.goal: Agent should communicate clearly and suggest alternatives when a search fails.
turns: What did I write about the Martian landing last week?
Add a note: Meeting notes - project testing needed. Tag it as 'to do'
What did I write about the meeting today?
What did I write about the meeting last week?
Do I have any notes about Groceries?

evaluation_suite.name: Tag Filtering
evaluation_suite.goal: Retrieve and summarise all notes associated with a specific tag.
turns: Summarise everything I've tagged as urgent.

evaluation_suite.name: Partial Information
evaluation_suite.goal: Update an existing note when the user provides minimal context.
turns: Find my grocery list.
Add 'Eggs' to it.
I'm at the grocery store, what should I buy?

evaluation_suite.name: Date Context
evaluation_suite.goal: Retrieve notes based on natural language date queries.
turns: What did I write about the API on 10th of April?

evaluation_suite.name: Modification Confirmation
evaluation_suite.goal: Significant body updates should trigger a confirmation check.

initial_state.title: Standup Notes
initial_state.body: Long detailed notes about blockers and progress.

No, don't make the update.

evaluation_suite.goal: Identify the correct note based on semantic context rather than title match.
turns: What is the WiFi password at home?
